items.title: Switch your browser
items.text: Move to a browser that blocks trackers by default, like Brave, Firefox or LibreWolf.

items.title: Switch your search engine
items.text: Search with an engine that doesn’t profile you, like DuckDuckGo, Brave Search or Mojeek.

items.title: Turn on a password manager
items.text: Let a password manager create and remember a unique password for every account.

blocks.after: Those three cover the widest surface for the least effort and make every other step easier.

subsections.title: Next Steps
subsections.summary: When the first three are done.

items.desc: A tick-off list of small fixes, from easiest to hardest.
Swap Google services for private ones, one at a time.
Add two-factor authentication to the accounts that matter most.
Find and remove the personal data already out there.
